id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying pii restricted graphql errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Shopify warehouse connector support for PII access restriction errors, classifying them as non-retryable to prevent unnecessary retry loops.
review.reason: Adds a new error constant, registers it, and provides a handler with a user-facing message. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the Shopify warehouse ingestion path. The implementation and relevant checks are visible. Tier 3 is not assigned because the complete matching behavior and its effect on the import workflow are not demonstrated. Tier 1 is not awarded
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the error matching or the complete context of the ShopifySource class, so while the error constants and their usage are added, the actual matching behavior and its effect on the import workflow are not demonstrated. This makes it difficult to assess the tier.
